title: auto-man cross-run architecture delta (~/.claude/auto-man/arch-delta.jsonl)
description: One line per completed run — a mechanically-derived summary of what SHAPE of the system changed, deliberately NOT the diff itself. Exists so a human owner can review O(subsystems) per batch (see SKILL.md Step 8) instead of O(diffs) per run. Distinct from ledger.jsonl: the ledger is quantitative run telemetry (cost/turns/outcome) sized for MAX_TURNS derivation; this file is qualitative 'what changed shape', sized for a human batch review. Append-only: never rewrite a prior line except to set reviewedAt, and only Step 8 may do that, only after explicit human acknowledgment.

project.description: Project name or path, for grouping in batch review

runRef.description: This run's LOOP_RUN_ID or the delivered commit hash — lets a batch review pull the full diff for one flagged row without needing anything else

diffLoc.description: Total lines added+removed across the final diff

deletedTests.description: Test files removed by this run's diff, by path

riskFlags.description: Mechanically-detected touch on a fixed list of high-blast-radius areas (kept in sync with arch-delta.sh.tmpl and SKILL.md Step 0's plan-risk classification). A NON-EMPTY array means Step 6's report to the user must recommend immediate review of THIS run's diff — do not let it wait for the next Step 8 batch.

criteriaShapes.description: Copied from this same run's ledger.jsonl row (see ledger.schema.json) so a Step 8 batch review can see verification strength without cross-referencing two files. A grep-heavy shape is itself a reason to review now even with an empty riskFlags — a structural check only proves a shape exists, not that the behavior works.

reviewedAt.description: Null means still pending a human's eyes. Set ONLY by Step 8, ONLY on that row after the human has actually acknowledged it (individually, or as part of an explicitly-accepted 'delivered clean' rollup) — Step 6 must always write null here. A row silently marked reviewed without a human having looked defeats the entire point of this file.

notes.description: Free-text one-liner, e.g. why a risk flag fired if not obvious from the file list alone
